core.headline: Extended four-bedroom detached house on 0.3-acre plot
core.summary: Extended detached house in Sevenoaks offering four bedrooms, two reception rooms and a kitchen/family room, set on a 0.3-acre plot with a double garage and driveway parking at a guide price of £850,000
core.listing:
A four-bedroom detached house on Beech Avenue, Sevenoaks, built in 1968 and set on a 0.3-acre plot. The property has been extended to create a kitchen/family room and includes a double garage with driveway parking.

The ground floor provides two reception rooms and an extended kitchen/family room. Gas central heating serves the property.

Four bedrooms are arranged over the first floor, served by two bathrooms.

Outside, the 0.3-acre plot includes a rear garden. The double garage is accessed from the driveway.

Beech Avenue is located in Sevenoaks.

The property is offered at a guide price of £850,000 and is freehold. Council Tax Band G applies (Sevenoaks District Council). The EPC rating is D. Construction is standard. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating are connected. FTTC broadband is available, and there is good outdoor mobile signal coverage on major networks. Parking is provided by the driveway. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining issues are none known. Japanese knotweed was found in the rear garden near the boundary in 2025; a herbicide treatment plan by a PCA-registered contractor is in progress, with a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee.
